title: eulalia ridleyi
intro: Eulalia ridleyi, commonly known as East Indian sandalwood, is a type of aromatic grass that belongs to the Poaceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly in traditional Indian and Ayurvedic medicine, where it is used to promote relaxation, reduce stress and anxiety, and improve sleep quality. The health benefits of Eulalia ridleyi include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations, wounds, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Eulalia ridleyi include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of sedation, analgesia, and antioxidant activity.
